summary: Aegon Ltd furnished a Form 6-K attaching an August 20, 2026 press release announcing a CFO transition tied to the planned relocation of its head office and legal seat to the United States. Aegon agreed with Duncan Russell that he will step down as Chief Financial Officer and leave the company in April 2027; a successor search has begun. CEO Lard Friese praised Russell's contributions, and Russell committed to an orderly transition. This is a planned, amicable departure rather than a forced or abrupt boardroom event. No terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed; watch for successor timing and any strategy implications from the US redomiciliation.
